bio: Welcome to Harvard! I am so honored to serve as your Proctor for the 2025-2026 school year. I am currently working on my masters degree focused on Religions of the Americas at the Harvard Divinity School. As a child of immigrant parents and a first-generation college graduate, I understand how difficult it can be to study away from home... but I am eager to support you through any challenges and celebrate your accomplishments (big or small)! Originally from Los Angeles, CA, I came to the Boston-area to study Anthropology and Latinx Studies at Wellesley College. After being in MA for nearly a decade, I am pumped to show you around the city and give you recommendations for the best Mexican restaurant (hint: it is not in the Square, sorry!). I live with my partner, Liv, and our precious dog, Koda. Liv is a professional frisbee player and is currently a coach for Harvard Quasar, the women's frisbee team. She is also a graduate of the College and the Harvard Graduate School of Education, so she is equally happy to be a resource for you student-athletes, English majors, frisbee aficionados, and aspiring teachers! Ask me about PBHA (Harvard's student-run nonprofit), Mesoamerican religions, RuPaul's Drag Race, and about your zodiac sign! Can't wait to meet you!
